title: Corporation property licence
summary: This page provides information about the corporation property licence, including how to apply for, renew, or manage the licence.
who_can_apply: The applicant must be a corporation that owns or manages property in New South Wales.
what_you_need: Details of the property or properties in question.
Corporate identification documents (e.g., ABN, company registration details).

internal_links.text: Apply for a corporation property licence
Change the details on a property certificate or licence
Check a property agent licence or certificate
Surrender a property certificate or licence

faqs.q: What is a corporation property licence?
faqs.a: A corporation property licence is required for corporations that own or manage property in New South Wales.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a corporation property licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a corporation property licence using the dedicated application page.

faqs.q: What if I need to renew or replace my licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence or replace it using the specific online services available.
